cases.title: The Clockmaker's Window
setup: At closing time, a gold pocket watch vanished from the clock shop window.

suspects.name: ROSA
suspects.say: Rosa, the clockmaker: I was winding clocks in the back room.
suspects.slip: "I was winding clocks in the back room."

suspects.name: MILO
suspects.say: Milo, the delivery boy: I left at eight.

suspects.name: JUNE
suspects.say: June, a customer: I only stopped in to fix my strap.
suspects.slip: "I only stopped in to fix my strap."

suspects.name: AUGUST
suspects.say: August, the night porter: I never went near the window.

clues.label: WINDOW CASE
clues.say: The window case was opened at eight thirty.

clues.label: DOOR LOG
clues.text: Milo out 8:00 · June out 8:45 · August in 9:00
clues.say: The door log: Milo out at eight, June out at eight forty five, August in at nine.

clues.label: BACK ROOM
clues.say: And every back room clock was wound between eight twenty and eight forty.

question: WHO TOOK THE WATCH?
why: Milo had left, August hadn't arrived, and Rosa was winding clocks.

cases.title: The Frozen Pond
setup: The skating club's silver trophy vanished on a freezing night.

suspects.name: NELL
suspects.say: Nell, the coach: I locked the clubhouse at six.

suspects.name: OTTO
suspects.say: Otto, the groundskeeper: I rowed across the pond at seven.
suspects.slip: "I rowed across the pond at seven."

suspects.name: PIA
suspects.say: Pia, a skater: I skated laps until half past six.
suspects.slip: "I skated laps until half past six."

clues.label: WEATHER CARD
clues.say: The weather card: below freezing all week.

clues.label: THE POND
clues.say: And the pond had been frozen solid since Monday.

question: WHO IS LYING?
why: You can't row across a pond that's frozen solid.

cases.title: The Poolside Note
setup: A gold medal was stolen at the swim meet, and the thief left a coded note.
cases.noteSay: The note reads: Z H V W, O R F N H U, twelve.

clues.label: ON THE BACK
clues.text: Shift each letter back. Key = lanes, halved.
clues.say: On the back: shift each letter back. The key is the number of lanes, halved.

question: WHERE IS THE MEDAL?
why: Six lanes halved is three, so every letter moves back three.
